name: HICO
description: We introduce a new benchmark "Humans Interacting with Common Objects" (HICO) for recognizing human-object interactions (HOI). We demonstrate the key features of HICO: a diverse set of interactions with common object categories, a list of well-defined, sense-based HOI categories, and an exhaustive labeling of co-occurring interactions with an object category in each image. We perform an in-depth analysis of representative current approaches and show that DNNs enjoy a significant edge. In addition, we show that semantic knowledge can significantly improve HOI recognition, especially for uncommon categories.
reputation: A widely used and influential benchmark in human–object interaction (HOI) research with strong adoption in the computer vision community.
notes: Long-tail/imbalance across interaction classes, distinct Full/Rare evaluation splits, potential label noise; non-LLM vision benchmark.
